playbookOutputs: PPRA Firm Registration & Principal Fidelity Fund Certificate (FFC) Application Dossier
Auditor / Trust Account Exemption Resolution & Affidavit Pack
MyPPRA Portal Submission Receipt & Statutory Fee Voucher
playbookCommonFailures: Missing or expired B-BBEE Certificate or SARS TCS PIN (both are hard statutory blocks under Section 50 of the Property Practitioners Act)
Bank account confirmation letter does not explicitly designate the account as a Section 54(1) Trust Account when the firm intends to hold client deposits

informationToProvide.label: Principal Agent Full Name, ID & Personal FFC / Qualifications
informationToProvide.aiHint: Details of the principal property practitioner holding NQF 5 / PDE 5 credentials.

informationToProvide.label: Auditor / Accounting Officer Appointment Letter
informationToProvide.aiHint: If holding a trust account, auditor confirmation letter. If exempt, we draft the exemption affidavit.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Principal Property Practitioners & Directors (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) for all principals and directors of the property firm.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Valid SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN Letter & Valid B-BBEE Certificate / Sworn Affidavit
informationToProvide.helpText: Under Section 50 of the Property Practitioners Act, the PPRA strictly requires both a valid SARS Tax Clearance PIN and a valid B-BBEE Certificate/Affidavit before issuing a Fidelity Fund Certificate (FFC).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid SARS TCS PIN letter and signed B-BBEE Sworn Affidavit or SANAS B-BBEE Certificate in the property firm name.

informationToProvide.label: Section 54(1) Trust Account Bank Confirmation Letter (< 3 Months) OR Confirmation That the Firm Will Apply for a Trust Account Exemption
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your dedicated Section 54(1) Trust Account bank confirmation letter (< 3 months), or leave blank if the firm will not hold trust monies and requires us to draft the PPRA Trust Account Exemption Affidavit & Resolution.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank confirmation letter specifically referencing a Section 54(1) Property Practitioners Trust Account in the firm name.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect firm, principal practitioner, and auditor documents
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CIPC, tax PIN, principal FFC, and trust bank status verified

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft PPRA statutory declarations and exemption affidavits
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: FIC compliance check and trust exemption affidavit prepared

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Lodge firm registration on MyPPRA portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Firm profile registered on MyPPRA and reference number generated

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver filing proof and PPRA fee voucher to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Submission receipt and next steps sent to client
